description: This file defines an interface 'MuteableConnectionLogger' that extends another interface 'ConnectionLogger'. It provides methods to mute, unmute, and check the mute status of a connection logger within a messaging service, likely used for monitoring or controlling message logging behavior.

classes.name: MuteableConnectionLogger
classes.description: An interface for a connection logger that can be muted or unmuted, enabling control over message logging in a messaging service.

methods.name: mute
methods.description: Mutes the logger, so no messages will be stored after muting.

methods.name: unmute
methods.description: Unmutes the logger, allowing messages to be stored again.

methods.name: isMuted
methods.description: Checks if the logger is currently muted, returning true if it is.
